title: When the Lantern Turns
author: Edmund Ishikawa
blurb: Astrid Crane, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the century turns.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
